name: markupcraft-test
description: Node build of pdf.js (the legacy build; the MarkupCraft browser UI vendors the modern build) so bin/test-markupcraft.mjs can re-read saved PDFs outside a browser. pdf-lib is loaded from the vendored copy directly. Keep versions in step with public_html/assets/vendor/*/current. tesseract.js (Node build) runs the same OCR engine and data as the vendored browser copy (assets/vendor/tesseract/current) for bin/test-markupcraft.mjs and the OCR measurements.
